Title: Reply to first comment in AskReddit thread
Description: Step-by-step workflow to locate a specific post and reply to its first comment
- Start at the home page and navigate to 'Forums' via the visible link.
- Click the target forum link (e.g., 'AskReddit — AskReddit') from the forums index.
- On the forum listing, click the 'comments' link under the target post to open the thread.
- Identify the first reply in the comment list and click its 'Reply' link.
- Enter the required text (e.g., 'don't panic') into the visible 'Comment' textbox.
- Click the 'Post' button in the reply form to submit the comment.
- Verify the new comment appears in the thread after submission.

Title: Common pitfalls when replying to forum comments
Description: Key UI signals and navigation traps observed during the failed initial attempt
- A 404 Not Found page indicates the current URL does not contain the target post; navigate to 'Forums' to recover.
- The 'Forums' link is visible on the home page but may show no posts directly; use it to reach the forum index.
- Use 'go_back()' and 'go_forward()' if navigation history is needed to return to the forums index.
- Do not assume the target post is the first one shown; verify the post title and comment count.
- The 'Reply' link is specific to individual comments, not the main post; locate it under the first reply.
- The 'Comment' textbox is required and described by 'reply_to_comment_..._comment_help' attributes.
- Submission requires clicking the 'Post' button; previewing the text does not count as posting.
- If the thread URL changes after posting (e.g., includes 'comment/1'), the reply was likely successful.
